fee_notes: Standard Franchise $35,000. Conversion Franchises $25,000. Related Franchisees receive 25% discount ($26,250 for up to 2 franchises purchased simultaneously). Expansion Franchises for existing franchisees $30,000. Veterans (honorably discharged) receive 20% discount; first responders receive $2,500 discount; industry-experienced operators (2+ years, licensed) receive 10% discount. Discounts not combinable.
raw_excerpt: Upon signing the Franchise Agreement, you must pay an initial franchise fee of $35,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). The Initial Franchise Fee is due when you sign the franchise agreement and is non-refundable.
